{{Quote|Will somebody get this big walking carpet out of my way?|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], referring to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''carpet''', or '''rug'''<ref name="swg">{{GalaxiesAED}} refers to the carpet as a rug, but it is obviously the same as a carpet</ref> was a covering of the floor used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Types of carpet==
*'''[[Wrodian carpet]]''' was a luxurious carpet with rich colors and a fine weave. These could take generations to complete.<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>

*'''[[Flex-carpet]]''' was developed shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It was used in upscale residences, and had an internal heating system.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>

*'''Foam-carpet''' was not technically carpet, but it was an inexpensive replacement which could be sprayed directly onto the floor to create a soft cushion.<ref name="Star Wars Insider 73">[[Star Wars Insider 73|''Star Wars Insider'' 73]]</ref>

*'''[[Huj mat]]s''' were types of rugs woven with an assortment of colors and shapes.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>

The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Harswee]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] world located in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]], was known for luxurious loom-woven rugs. The [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], the personal [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], made extensive use of Harswee carpeting.<ref name="TCWIV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> The Mandalorian [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|leader]] known as [[Mandalore the Binder]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Harswee, where he grew up as the son of one of the world's rug weavers.<ref name="TBHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

Residences of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] were known to create handwoven carpets.<ref name="dl">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

==Common phrases==
{{Quote|These rugs really tie the room together.|Meatlump King|<ref name="swg" />}}
[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were often derogatorily referred to as "carpet-bags" during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were also referred to as "walking carpets" under a similarly derogatory manner, notably being used towards the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="anh" /><ref name="swhs">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

"Red carpet" was a slang term used by some members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to describe a large quantity of explosives.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
